nodes.description: Call any Typeform API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/forms/<id>/messages". Only the API's own host is allowed. Agent tools may only read /me, /forms, /forms/{id}, /forms/{id}/responses, /forms/{id}/messages, /workspaces, /themes, /images and /insights/{id}/summary.
